title: Beautiful Arrangement
description:
For an integer `n`, consider permutations `perm` of the integers `1` through `n`. A permutation is beautiful when, at every 1-indexed position `i`, either `perm[i]` is divisible by `i` or `i` is divisible by `perm[i]`. Return the number of beautiful permutations.

## Examples

```text
Input: n = 2
Output: 2
Explanation: Both [1, 2] and [2, 1] are beautiful.
```

```text
Input: n = 1
Output: 1
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= n <= 15`
